description: This file defines the 'Hyperlink' class within the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel namespace. It handles creation, cloning, and serialization of hyperlink objects, supporting various types such as URL, file, bookmark, and external bookmark. The class provides multiple constructors and factory methods for hyperlink creation, property accessors for hyperlink attributes, methods for adding document elements to the hyperlink, and visitor pattern implementation.

classes.name: Hyperlink
classes.description: Represents a hyperlink object that can reference document targets, files, or URLs. Supports cloning, serialization, and various types of links, with properties to control behavior and appearance.

classes.name: Hyperlink.HyperlinkValues
classes.description: Internal class holding the nullable property values for a Hyperlink instance, including target filename, bookmark, style options, and elements.
